description: Investigate fundamental data representation issue - root cause analysis
conclusion: SUPPORTED - Early stopping resolves the overfitting issue

key_findings.root_cause: The 100%+ 'underfitting' was actually SEVERE OVERFITTING due to training too long without early stopping

v1_findings.observation: Identity task should be trivial but showed worst performance

v2_findings.insight: GRU memorizes training data perfectly but doesn't generalize

v3_findings.insight: Early stopping reduces overfitting from 288682% to 15%

v4_findings.insight: CognitiveGraph with early stopping achieves 2.1% underfit on original LIBERO data

recommendations: R1: Add early stopping to all future experiments
R2: Re-evaluate previous experiments with early stopping
R3: The 'underfitting' problem was actually overfitting - need to revisit conclusions
R4: CognitiveGraph architecture is validated - 2.1% underfit is excellent

implications.h1_status: STRONGLY SUPPORTED - Cognitive Graph shows 2.1% underfit vs 46.8% for SimpleGRU
implications.prior_experiments: Need to re-run with early stopping to validate conclusions
implications.data_quality: Original LIBERO-style data is actually good - temporal structure not necessary
